question: Which of the following is the smallest inhabited island in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bitra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bitra** is the smallest inhabited island in the **Union Territory of Lakshadweep**.
 
• It has an area of approximately **0.105 square kilometers**, making it the tiniest inhabited landmass in the region.
 
• The island is known for its **pristine natural beauty** and is part of the **archipelago of 36 islands**, out of which only 10 are inhabited.
 
• Bitra is one of the **most sparsely populated** islands in Lakshadweep.
 
• The island is located in the **Arabian Sea**, and its inhabitants primarily rely on **fishing** and **coconut cultivation** for their livelihood.
 
• Bitra is surrounded by a rich ecosystem, including **coral reefs** and marine biodiversity, making it significant for ecological studies.
 
• It is part of the **Lakshadweep Islands**, which are governed under the administration of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Agatti**__

 __
 
• **Agatti** is another inhabited island in the Lakshadweep archipelago.
 
• It is known for its **beautiful beaches** and **coral reefs**, making it a popular destination for tourism.
 
• The island has an area of approximately **3.84 square kilometers**.
 
• Agatti is famous for its **marine biodiversity**, including species of fish and turtles.
 
 
 
• **Kavaratti**__
 __
 
• **Kavaratti** is the capital of the **Union Territory of Lakshadweep.**
 
• It is one of the most developed islands and serves as the **administrative headquarters**.
 
• The island covers an area of **3.93 square kilometers**.
 
• Kavaratti is known for its **water sports activities** and its **marine aquarium**.
 
 
 
• **Minicoy**__
 
 
• **Minicoy** is the second-largest island in Lakshadweep.
 
• It has an area of **4.8 square kilometers**.
 
• Minicoy is culturally distinct, as it has influences from the **Maldive Islands**.
 
• The island is known for its **lighthouse**, which is one of the oldest landmarks in the region.
